title: gui config
description: Settings of the gui module: the local backend (port, browser), command runs, the event stream, log retention and queries. The backend listens on loopback only; there is no host key.

port.description: TCP port of the loopback backend; 0 picks a free port at every start. Machine-wide: one backend serves every project.

open_browser.description: Whether gui open starts the default browser with the session URL (the URL is printed either way).

runs.description: Limits of command runs started by the ExecutionBroker.

max_global.description: Runs active at the same time on the machine; a new run beyond it is refused with CONCURRENCY_LIMIT.

max_per_project.description: Runs active at the same time in one project.

max_per_owner.description: Runs active at the same time of one contribution owner.

chunk_bytes.description: Largest log chunk of one stream frame in bytes.

log_max_bytes.description: Largest stored log of one output stream (stdout or stderr) of a run in bytes; the rest is dropped and marked.

idle_timeout_s.description: A run without output for this many seconds is stopped as timed_out; 0 never stops it.

cancel_grace_s.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL of the process group when a run is cancelled.

ring_frames.description: Frames kept in memory for resume after a reconnect.

queue_frames.description: Frames queued per subscription before the subscriber is told to resync.

heartbeat_s.description: Seconds between heartbeat frames of an idle subscription.

journal_poll_s.description: Seconds between reads of the project event journal.

log_days.description: Run logs older than this many days are removed; 0 keeps them.

log_total_mb.description: Run logs are removed oldest first above this total size in MiB; 0 has no ceiling.

lock_timeout_s.description: Seconds a commit waits for the lock of a layer file held by another writer before it answers CONFIG_LOCKED.

preview_ttl_s.description: Seconds a preview can be committed after it was made; the store keeps at most 64 previews in memory.

max_output_bytes.description: Largest canonical JSON output of one query handler in bytes; a larger one is OUTPUT_INVALID.
